title: Evaluate tests of controls — Lindqvist Distributors
instructions: You tested three controls over Lindqvist's purchasing cycle using attribute sampling. The upper deviation rates come from the firm's evaluation tables. Evaluate each control.

exhibits.title: Test results
exhibits.content:
| Control | Sample size | Deviations | Upper deviation rate | Tolerable rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A. Purchase orders approved before ordering | 60 | 0 | 4.9% | 6% |
| B. Three-way match before payment | 60 | 2 | 10.3% | 7% |
| C. Vendor master file changes approved | 50 | 1 | 9.2% | 10% |

The deviation in control C was a change to a vendor's bank account made and approved by the CFO alone, contrary to policy.

rows.label: Control A
options: Do not rely; increase substantive testing

rows.label: Control B
options: Do not rely; increase substantive testing
rows.answer: Do not rely; increase substantive testing

rows.label: Control C — overall conclusion
options: Rely as planned, because the rate is within the tolerable rate
Weigh its nature: possible override and fraud risk
Ignore it, because only a single deviation was found in the sample
rows.answer: Weigh its nature: possible override and fraud risk
rows.explanation: A deviation involving management overriding a key control over vendor bank details has qualitative significance; evaluate fraud implications, the effect on risk assessment, and whether it is a significant deficiency or material weakness.
